svg.aria-label: What the watch sees: a Lead's or Peer's timeline folds into a window. Code reads facts from it and from each lane's record. Beside the code, one reader chosen by attention.by: a Watcher seat, the default, mailed readings of the new steps and answering with raise and judge; or Jev, only with a key, asked about four views of the turn's trail, with the step it meant pinpointed. Incidents are kept one per seat, kind and reader; an attend-level one about a Peer goes to its Lead, one about a Lead, a page, or one whose Lead is gone to the Supervisor, and whoever gets it marks it with ack; calibrate reads the marks against what was kept.

svg.text: Code reads the facts, one reader reads the work, and whoever answers for the seat decides. The seat never hears of it.
at a pace while it works,
and at once when a turn
IN CODE: TURNS AND LANE RECORDS
BY A WATCHER SEAT · THE DEFAULT
BY JEV · ONLY WITH A KEY
about a Lead, a page, or
a Peer whose Lead is gone
ack useful · noise · unknown, from the agent's own record
attention.by picks the reader. A Watcher seat needs no key; Jev needs one, and without it nothing is watched.
Mailing incidents is a second switch, off by default: until it is on they are kept and listed, never sent.
